question: Which dance style is associated with the story of lord Krishna and his queen Satyabhama ‘Bhaamaakalaapam’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kuchipudi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bhaamaakalaapam** is a traditional dance-drama from **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• This dance-drama is associated with the **Kuchipudi** dance style.
 
• It narrates the story of **Lord Krishna** and his queen **Satyabhama**.&
